name: Legacy global page header
purpose: Open a legacy-themed utility or index page with a simple H1 and one supporting paragraph (no CTA).
description: Top + side hairline frame (no bottom border) with legacy header padding. One component with `variant`: 'eyebrow' (/contact-us; centred eyebrow tag, H1 3.8rem/1.1, grey paragraph) and 'logo' (/case-studies/content; centred content-brand logo, H1 3.8rem/1.15, grey paragraph that keeps the original's 12rem left offset). No buttons. The file also exports the shared legacy theme primitives (legacyVars, LegacyButton, LegacyEyebrow).

theme.note: Legacy page colour theme (legacyVars): green, yellow (content pages) or pink (impact).
